description: Catalog lookup behavior (get_product_terms), exercised deterministically by lib/catalog/*.test.ts and convex/catalog.test.ts. No provider calls.

cases.scenario: Value imported from comparatie.csv but not yet reviewed
cases.expect: listed as unavailable (unreviewed); no figure returned

cases.scenario: Source states the value is missing ("nu apare pe pagină", "indisponibil")
Query asks for fees of a product with no fee record
Unknown product ID or a product from the other track
3-month standard rate vs 6-month or bonus rate
Anonymous caller or business track without an organization
cases.expect: rejected before the catalog is read

cases.scenario: Operator, or a value without a located quote, is marked reviewed
cases.expect: forbidden / quote_not_found; admin review writes an audit entry

cases.scenario: Percentage in the catalog appears only as a month count on the page ("4%" vs "4 luni")
